methods.name: Lag, lead, diff and pct_change as dplyr::lag / lead (positional, within groups)
methods.reference: dplyr::lag, dplyr::lead (group_by); x - lag(x, k); (y - lag(y)) / lag(y)
methods.tolerance: exact for integers; 1e-14 relative for double differences and ratios (the same IEEE operations as R)

methods.name: Equal-width and quantile bins as base::cut on integer data with NA
methods.reference: base::cut(x, breaks = n); cut(x, c(-Inf, quantile(x, (1:(n-1))/n, type = 7, na.rm = TRUE), Inf))

deviations.note: p2a drops an arbitrary level, R's treatment contrast drops the first sorted level; drop_first is not pinned (Tier 4)
text levels are named with quotes (region_"west") and NA gets a dummy; only an integer factor is pinned (Tier 4)

methods.name: Melt as tidyr::pivot_longer (types and missing values)
quantities: id, variable and value columns in row-major order

methods.name: Mode fill as names(which.max(table(x))) and tidyr::replace_na
quantities: mode (ties to the first sorted level) for integer, double and text columns

methods.name: Replace a sentinel by a missing value as dplyr::na_if
quantities: integer, double and text columns after na_if

methods.name: Value counts and proportions as dplyr::count
methods.reference: dplyr::count(d, g, sort = TRUE); n / sum(n)

methods.name: Column summaries (count, mean, sd, min, max) with na.rm
methods.reference: sum(!is.na(x)); mean, sd, min, max (na.rm = TRUE)
methods.tolerance: count, min, max exact; mean Tol::coef(n), sd Tol::stat(n) (validation/README.md); measured agreement about 1e-15

methods.name: Join column names under suffix collisions as dplyr (add_suffixes)
methods.reference: dplyr::left_join / inner_join / right_join / full_join(keep = TRUE) / cross_join, suffix = c('', '_right')
quantities: output column names per join type

deviations.note: p2a's full join keeps both key columns (k, k_right); pinned against full_join(keep = TRUE); dplyr's default coalesces them (Tier 4)

methods.name: Row filter with missing values as dplyr::filter
quantities: kept row ids (integer and double conditions with NA)
